sourceNote: Sun & Moon era estimate, ANCHORED to the one primary measurement that exists for the era: the Elite Fourum tally of Sun & Moon base (sm1) at n=7,020 packs, which measured Holo GX 11.15%, full-art Ultra Rare 4.22%, Rainbow 1.47% and Secret 0.81% - so ultra_rare 15.37% and hyper_rare 2.28% on our tiers. Those figures are applied here in place of the previous unsourced 18%/3% aggregate. CONFIDENCE STAYS LOW, DELIBERATELY, for two reasons. First, this is a measurement of a DIFFERENT SET: no counted study of this set was found, and Sun & Moon sets are known to vary - the same thread reports Cosmic Eclipse (sm12) at roughly 28% overall against sm1's 17.65%, which if real would mean later sets in the era are considerably richer than this table assumes. Second, even the sm1 anchor is video-sourced and unauditable (see the sm1 table's note). A dedicated 2026 research pass across five search angles found NO other primary, sample-sized study for any Sun & Moon set.
